features.name: inter_arrival_mean
features.recommended_measurement: Mean of consecutive event-time gaps in a declared direction/key; retain interval count and timestamp resolution.
features.current_limit: Legacy timestamp subsampling above 2,000 observations changes adjacent gaps; burst durations are milliseconds. Site only exports mean/SD/CV, not extrema or episodes.
features.qualification: Use adjacent event times, stable moments and explicit support. Compare per peer/service and multiple horizons; low CV also describes ordinary IoT telemetry.

features.qualification: Use adjacent event times, stable moments and explicit support. Compare per peer/service and multiple horizons; low CV also describes ordinary IoT telemetry.

features.name: fwd_packet_count
features.recommended_measurement: Count originator packets in an identity/context-bound canonical bidirectional session or declared device window.
features.current_limit: Legacy reverse aggregates are IP-pair/protocol, not full sessions; +1 ratio smoothing and raw reply ratio are not success probabilities.
features.qualification: Use canonical biflow identity, declared originator/responder direction and matching exposure/byte layer. Preserve no-reply and unseen-reply as distinct states.

features.name: bwd_packet_count
features.recommended_measurement: Count matched responder packets for that same canonical session/context; report observation coverage.
features.current_limit: Legacy reverse aggregates are IP-pair/protocol, not full sessions; +1 ratio smoothing and raw reply ratio are not success probabilities.
features.qualification: Use canonical biflow identity, declared originator/responder direction and matching exposure/byte layer. Preserve no-reply and unseen-reply as distinct states.

features.name: fwd_bwd_packet_ratio
features.recommended_measurement: Forward / reverse packet count with explicit denominator and undefined/no-reply state; smoothing must be declared.
features.current_limit: Legacy reverse aggregates are IP-pair/protocol, not full sessions; +1 ratio smoothing and raw reply ratio are not success probabilities.
features.qualification: Use canonical biflow identity, declared originator/responder direction and matching exposure/byte layer. Preserve no-reply and unseen-reply as distinct states.

features.name: fwd_bwd_bytes_ratio
features.recommended_measurement: Forward / reverse bytes at the same layer; preserve zero-denominator state and optional declared log-ratio.
features.current_limit: Legacy reverse aggregates are IP-pair/protocol, not full sessions; +1 ratio smoothing and raw reply ratio are not success probabilities.
features.qualification: Use canonical biflow identity, declared originator/responder direction and matching exposure/byte layer. Preserve no-reply and unseen-reply as distinct states.

features.name: fwd_avg_packet_size
features.recommended_measurement: Forward captured bytes / forward packets; null with no forward support.
features.current_limit: Legacy reverse aggregates are IP-pair/protocol, not full sessions; +1 ratio smoothing and raw reply ratio are not success probabilities.
features.qualification: Use canonical biflow identity, declared originator/responder direction and matching exposure/byte layer. Preserve no-reply and unseen-reply as distinct states.

features.name: bwd_avg_packet_size
features.recommended_measurement: Reverse captured bytes / reverse packets; null with no reverse support.
features.current_limit: Legacy reverse aggregates are IP-pair/protocol, not full sessions; +1 ratio smoothing and raw reply ratio are not success probabilities.
features.qualification: Use canonical biflow identity, declared originator/responder direction and matching exposure/byte layer. Preserve no-reply and unseen-reply as distinct states.

features.name: reply_rate
features.recommended_measurement: Use matched request-response successes / eligible requests for true responsiveness; raw reverse/forward counts are a different metric.
features.current_limit: Legacy reverse aggregates are IP-pair/protocol, not full sessions; +1 ratio smoothing and raw reply ratio are not success probabilities.
features.qualification: Use canonical biflow identity, declared originator/responder direction and matching exposure/byte layer. Preserve no-reply and unseen-reply as distinct states.

features.name: syn_ack_ratio
features.recommended_measurement: Separate initial SYN attempts from retransmissions; compare eligible handshakes with matching SYN-ACK/ACK progression.
features.current_limit: Legacy completed_sessions is a 0/1 window proxy and incomplete_ratio uses +1 smoothing. Exact session state is planned.
features.qualification: Use bounded persistent sequence-aware TCP state, deduplicated attempts, explicit timeout/censoring and matched completion outcomes.

features.name: completed_sessions
features.recommended_measurement: Count sequence-consistent established sessions in a bounded persistent five-tuple state machine, not a window-level Boolean.
features.current_limit: Legacy completed_sessions is a 0/1 window proxy and incomplete_ratio uses +1 smoothing. Exact session state is planned.
features.qualification: Use bounded persistent sequence-aware TCP state, deduplicated attempts, explicit timeout/censoring and matched completion outcomes.

features.name: incomplete_ratio
features.recommended_measurement: Uncompleted eligible attempts / eligible attempts after an explicit timeout; distinguish pending, censored and unobserved.
features.current_limit: Legacy completed_sessions is a 0/1 window proxy and incomplete_ratio uses +1 smoothing. Exact session state is planned.
features.qualification: Use bounded persistent sequence-aware TCP state, deduplicated attempts, explicit timeout/censoring and matched completion outcomes.

features.name: avg_session_duration
features.recommended_measurement: Mean actual completed-session lifetime by declared start/end criteria; unfinished sessions are censored.
features.current_limit: Legacy completed_sessions is a 0/1 window proxy and incomplete_ratio uses +1 smoothing. Exact session state is planned.
features.qualification: Use bounded persistent sequence-aware TCP state, deduplicated attempts, explicit timeout/censoring and matched completion outcomes.

features.name: payload_size_entropy
features.recommended_measurement: Shannon entropy of the declared length categories; captured-frame size and payload length must have different names/contracts.
features.current_limit: Legacy size entropy is captured-frame size, not application payload. Entropy needs sample/context controls; high or low alone is not malicious.
features.qualification: Use categorical frequencies, Shannon H=-sum(p*log2(p)), count, richness and top share together. Test bias/normalization and distribution divergence under matched support.

features.name: src_port_entropy
features.recommended_measurement: Shannon entropy of source-port frequencies at a source/context/horizon scope; report sample count and category richness.
features.current_limit: Legacy size entropy is captured-frame size, not application payload. Entropy needs sample/context controls; high or low alone is not malicious.
features.qualification: Use categorical frequencies, Shannon H=-sum(p*log2(p)), count, richness and top share together. Test bias/normalization and distribution divergence under matched support.

features.name: icmp_type_entropy
features.recommended_measurement: Shannon entropy of observed ICMP family/type/code categories; separate IPv4/IPv6 and diagnostic traffic.
features.current_limit: Legacy size entropy is captured-frame size, not application payload. Entropy needs sample/context controls; high or low alone is not malicious.
features.qualification: Use categorical frequencies, Shannon H=-sum(p*log2(p)), count, richness and top share together. Test bias/normalization and distribution divergence under matched support.

features.name: arp_reply_rate
features.recommended_measurement: Observed ARP replies / actual elapsed observation interval; retain count and packet loss context.
features.current_limit: Legacy unsolicited/binding heuristics are not exact request matching. ARP does not cover IPv6 NDP and first-seen bindings can be poisoned.
features.qualification: Use chronological ARP request/reply and time-valid authenticated lease/port/binding context. Retain gratuitous/probe/failover controls.

features.name: arp_request_rate
features.recommended_measurement: Observed ARP requests / actual elapsed interval; classify legitimate probes/announcements separately.

features.qualification: Use chronological ARP request/reply and time-valid authenticated lease/port/binding context. Retain gratuitous/probe/failover controls.

features.name: arp_unsolicited_count

features.name: pkt_size_std
features.recommended_measurement: Sample SD of explicitly defined captured sizes using online moments; keep n and compare protocol/role context.
features.current_limit: Legacy small-packet boundary is below 64 captured bytes; site currently exports the outgoing size SD and BASE mean only.
features.qualification: Use stable sample moments plus declared size-band proportions. Retain support, frame layer/MTU/offloads and matched-volume benign controls.

features.name: pkt_size_variance
features.recommended_measurement: Sample variance M2/(n-1); ablate against SD because the two encode the same scalar information.
features.current_limit: Legacy small-packet boundary is below 64 captured bytes; site currently exports the outgoing size SD and BASE mean only.
features.qualification: Use stable sample moments plus declared size-band proportions. Retain support, frame layer/MTU/offloads and matched-volume benign controls.

features.name: small_pkt_ratio

features.name: large_pkt_ratio

features.name: packet_size_std

features.name: top_dst_port
features.recommended_measurement: Mode destination-port category; use service semantics/categorical encoding, not numeric distance.
features.current_limit: Legacy sequential score sorts a set, so it is density, not scan order; its ephemeral predicate excludes boundary 49152.
features.qualification: Use categorical port concentration, service edges and arrival-ordered probe patterns; compare a role/service baseline rather than numeric port distances.

features.name: top_dst_port_ratio

features.name: ephemeral_port_ratio

features.name: arp_broadcast_ratio

features.name: flows_per_window
features.recommended_measurement: Count new canonical connection/flow keys with LRU/time bounds; separate new arrivals from active entries and sessions.
features.current_limit: Legacy flows_per_window counts its four-field keys and an overflow aggregation cap, not switch-table occupancy or established sessions.
features.qualification: Count new canonical keys, active sessions and actual resource occupancy separately; measure exposure and state eviction.
